text:
alex_support: customer reported repeated 504/502 errors from /v1/rerank during peak this morning. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~2.4s. customer says it started after a batch job at ~13:02 UTC. trace_id=tr-8b9c4f

alex_support: minimal repro they sent (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"request_id\": \"acme-req-2026-03-17-1\",
  \"model\": \"r1-reranker-v2\",
  \"query\": \"best red widgets\",
  \"candidates\": [\"id1\",\"id2\", /* ... ~500 ids ... */],
  \"timeout_ms\": 3000
}
```

jamie_oncall: can you paste the exact API response they saw? 504 from gateway or 502 from backend?

alex_support: customer pasted this snippet: `504 Gateway Timeout` for ~70% of requests, others got `502 Bad Gateway` with body: `{\"error\":\"upstream timeout\"}`. They also reported a billing spike (lots of retries).

deploy-bot: deploy finished: service/ranker v2026.3.17-43 at 12:57 UTC

sam_sre: looking at infra metrics — at 13:00 we had a sudden qps jump on the rerank route + a retry storm from one API key. Gateway p95 spiked to 2.2s, backend worker queue grew, and the autoscaler didn't add pods fast enough due to cooldown settings.

noah_ml: the payload shows ~500 candidates. Rerank cost scales with candidate count; large fanout -> CPU + KV cache pressure. Also we saw many of those requests had `timeout_ms` low which causes retries from client. That combination can amplify load.

maria_prod: customer says their SDK retried automatically (5 retries). That explains billing surge. We need to offer credit and mitigation steps.

jamie_oncall: immediate steps: 1) disable retries for that API key (throttle) 2) ask customer to reduce candidates per request to <= 200 3) enable short-term route-scale target to shed load. Can infra flip a temporary circuit breaker?

sam_sre: provisional mitigations applied: limited concurrency for the API key, enabled 10s circuit breaker on rerank gateway, increased pod target by 30% for 1 hour. Monitoring alerts fired for queue length and 5xx rate.

alex_support: shared repro and suggested changes with customer. They can reduce SDK retries and lower candidates. Also asked for a HAR/trace if they still see errors.

noah_ml: longer term: add server-side candidate cap and soft-fail w/ best-effort when candidate_count > 300, plus a rate-limit response header so clients can backoff. Also add a model-side cheap-prefilter option to trim candidate lists before full rerank.

maria_prod: agreed. Also flag for billing review — propose a one-off credit and 30-day watch.

jamie_oncall: root-cause hypothesis: high-candidate requests + client retry loop -> gateway queueing -> backend timeouts -> 502/504s -> more retries. Action items assigned.

alex_support: customer confirmed errors dropped after we limited key and they reduced retries. Will follow up for formal RCA and credit. :white_check_mark:

sam_sre: saving links to graphs: CPU/queue dashboard, gateway 5xx dashboard, autoscaler activity. Will produce a short postmortem if we see recurrence.

noah_ml: notes for eng: consider optimizing low-latency path for rerank with large N (streamed scoring, incremental KV cache prefetch).

maria_prod: adding to roadmap: server-side candidate cap + billing protection for retry storms.

jamie_oncall: closing the urgent triage. tagging eng-runtime and billing for follow-up.

alex_support: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for updates from eng-runtime and billing.
